senses.gloss: श्लु (in gram.) N. of the Vikaraṇa [q.v.] of the 3rd class of roots in which there is elision of the conjugational affix अ (श्लु is one of the 3 technical terms [containing लु] for grammatical elision See 2. लुक्), Pāṇ. i, 1, 61 &c.
श्लु—वत् ind. as if there were श्लु, ib. iii, 1, 39.
